title: The category of coherent families on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $f:X\to B$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Define $\mathcal C_{X/B}$ over schemes over $S$ as follows. Its objects are $(T,b,M)$, with $b:T\to B$, where $M$ is a quasi-coherent module [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] on the sheaf fibre product $X_T=X\times_BT$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], finitely presented, flat over $T$, and with support proper over $T$ in the conventions of [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor] and [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Explicitly finite presentation is etale-local presentation by finite rank free modules, flatness is flatness of stalks over base local rings on etale charts, read through the restriction of modules to etale scheme charts [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction], and proper support is $M\simeq i_*N$ for a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X_T$, with $Z\to T$ proper [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties] and $N$ finite type quasi-coherent. Arrows over $v:T\to T_1$ are maps satisfying $b=b_1v$ together with isomorphisms $v_X^*M_1\simeq M$, using the canonical tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Identity and composition use its canonical unit identification $\mathrm{id}^*M\simeq M$ [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback] and composition identification $(v\circ w)^*\simeq w^*v^*$ [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition]. The projection forgets $b$ and $M$ and retains $T$. Categories over schemes and their fibre-groupoid conventions are [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids].
